verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents custom dashboards for analyzing cost, latency, volume and quality, including cost broken down by model, tag or user. Its Metrics API v2 also exposes aggregate cost, usage, latency, volume and score metrics, so eval scores can be charted too. missing for 10: explicit evidence of error-rate metrics in dashboards, detail on how dashboard widgets and filters are built, independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard feature.
